description: Follow a YouTube channel for the account (needs an API key): its new videos land in the account’s inbox (check_inbox) and notify the browsers that turned that on. Optionally only videos whose title has one of `words`, no Shorts, or only for the next `days`. With `moments`, each new video (not Shorts, up to 2 hours) is transcribed and up to 3 parts worth clipping are proposed on its inbox row, about `looking` when given; nothing is rendered or shared, each search counts as one download, up to 2 a day (10 on Pro). Following one already followed changes only the parts of its rule given. Playlists can’t be followed: YouTube lists only their first 15 videos, so new ones at the end never show. What it holds now is not news, except a video from the last 3 days. Up to 20 follows (100 on Pro); feeds are read every 15 minutes.

days.description: Stop following after this many days. Omit to follow until unfollowed.

looking.description: What the moments should be about, e.g. “where she talks about pricing”. Omit for the best of the video.

moments.description: Search each new video for moments worth clipping.

words.description: Only videos whose title has one of these are news (case and accents ignored). Omit for every video.

name: follow_channel
